mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of taking learners outside the classroom in order to make some observations, collections or classification of things in their natural domain."
Field trip is a means of taking learners outside the classroom in order to make some observations, collections or classification of things in their natural domain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a work plan of the teacher."
Lesson preparation is a work plan of the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of courses and content offered within the walls of a school or university."
A curriculum is a set of courses and content offered within the walls of a school or university.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a sponsored pre-arranged gathering of people, who come together based on a common interest."
Social function means a sponsored pre-arranged gathering of people, who come together based on a common interest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a central topic, subject, or message within a narrative."
A theme is a central topic, subject, or message within a narrative.
fib: ______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is a paramount factor influencing curriculum implementation because he Makes decisions and selects the content to teach from the curriculum.
Answer to SAE 2 The teacher is a paramount factor influencing curriculum implementation because he Makes decisions and selects the content to teach from the curriculum.
______ is a broad structure of concepts and guidelines that informs the school the education policy of the country.
A curriculum framework is a broad structure of concepts and guidelines that informs the school the education policy of the country.
______ is a time marked by a particular way of understanding the world through culture and technology.
A cultural period is a time marked by a particular way of understanding the world through culture and technology.
______ refers to the curriculum contents that are structured to reveal the relationships existing among the elements.
Curriculum organization refers to the curriculum contents that are structured to reveal the relationships existing among the elements.
